entities.summary: Papyrus 16, designated by 𝔓16, is an early copy of the New Testament in Greek. Originally, it may have been part of a papyrus manuscript of the Pauline Corpus of letters, but now only contains Philippians 3:10–17; 4:2–8. The manuscript has been paleographically assigned to the late 3rd century.
